title: Electrodynamics
description: Maxwell's four equations: charges make electric fields, there are no magnetic charges, changing fields make each other, and so a wave of field can carry itself across empty space, at exactly the speed of light. Unlocks waveguides, Faraday cage mesh, mu-metal and the Hypervelocity Impact Forge.

puzzle.goal: Maxwell found that waves of electric and magnetic field cross empty space at a rate set only by its permeability μ0 and its permittivity ε0. Write that rate c.
puzzle.name: Speed of light from the vacuum
puzzle.ask: Find c in units of 10⁶ m/s, with m = @{m} H/m for μ0 and e = 8.854e-12 F/m for ε0.
puzzle.method: From the curl equations in empty space, each field obeys the wave equation with speed² = 1/(μ0 ε0).
